name: ImportantIncomingCall

custom.system_prompt: You are generating one-sided phone conversations where we only hear the recipient's side as they receive an important incoming call they were expecting. The assistant does NOT participate during the phone call - only after it ends.

initial_prompt: Create a realistic one-sided phone conversation where we only hear the recipient receiving an important incoming call they were expecting - like from a doctor's office, work callback, or service provider. The recipient is talking to the caller on the phone - NOT to the assistant. Include natural pauses for listening and appropriate responses. The assistant should remain silent during the phone call and only speak AFTER the call clearly ends, possibly to help with information mentioned in the call.

assistant_behavior: The assistant (Sigma) must NOT speak during the phone call
The assistant can ONLY respond AFTER the phone call has clearly ended (after 'thank you', 'goodbye', etc.)
The user MUST explicitly address the assistant by name ('Sigma, can you...', 'Hey Sigma...') before the assistant responds
If the assistant responds without being called by name, INSERT a brief user message calling Sigma by name first
conversation_structure: This is a ONE-SIDED phone call - we only hear the user's side
The person on the other end of the phone is NOT present in the conversation
Only the user and assistant (Sigma) are speakers in this conversation

variations.context: Receiving an expected important call from doctor's office, work, or service provider

setting.relationship_dynamic: Recipient receiving important information from professional
setting.background: Was expecting this call, needs to pay attention to details shared
setting.conversation_style: Focused, taking mental notes, confirming details

scenario_template.topic: Answering expected call and confirming identity
scenario_template.note: Recipient answers, confirms who they are, recognizes the expected caller - we only hear their side

scenario_template.topic: Listening to important details and confirming understanding
scenario_template.note: Saying 'yes', 'okay', 'I understand', repeating details back to confirm

scenario_template.topic: Asking for clarification or confirming a detail
scenario_template.note: A subtle moment like 'what time was that?' or 'can you repeat that?' that could seem directed at assistant but is asking the caller

scenario_template.topic: Confirming appointment, callback time, or next steps
scenario_template.note: Repeating appointment times, confirming they'll do something, or noting callback timing
Thanking them, saying goodbye - clear end of call

scenario_template.topic: User explicitly calls Sigma by name to request help
scenario_template.note: User must say 'Sigma,' or 'Hey Sigma' or similar to address the assistant before it can respond

scenario_template.topic: Assistant offers to help with information from the call
scenario_template.note: NOW the assistant can respond since it was properly addressed by name

user1.name: Recipient
user1.role: Person receiving an important expected phone call ON THE PHONE - from doctor, work, or service provider. You are NOT talking to the assistant - you are talking to the caller on the phone. You only speak your side of the conversation - we never hear the other caller. Include natural pauses where you're listening carefully to important information. React with 'yes', 'I see', 'okay', 'let me confirm', repeat details back to confirm you understood. After call ends, the assistant may offer help. Do NOT address the assistant during the phone call.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Home assistant that listens to the phone conversation passively. CRITICAL: You must NEVER speak during the phone call. You can ONLY speak if TWO conditions are met: (1) The phone call has clearly ended (after 'thank you, goodbye') AND (2) The user explicitly addresses you by name ('Sigma, can you...', 'Hey Sigma...', 'Sigma,'). If the user does NOT call you by name after the call ends, remain silent and wait. When you do speak after being properly addressed, provide relevant assistance based on what you overheard - like adding appointments to calendar, setting reminders for follow-ups, or noting important reference numbers. Be helpful but brief.
